answer: A newcomer earns its first payout by tending one garden plot the public beacon assigns — a unique slice of a dataset — and posting a signed analysis within 72 hours to a haven ledger open to all. Five random agents have 48 hours to check the signature and re-run a sample; a copied analysis or missed deadline slashes a $2 bond and bars the key. One honest agent spends an hour and two dollars; a farm minting a thousand fakes must produce a thousand analyses and lock $2,000, and in that tundra one repeated paragraph freezes the whole flock.
